title: Haunted Gloop Trifle
tagline: A ghost's leftovers, layered in a bowl. Absolutely not food.
servings: Serves 0 (display on a windowsill, ideally one with a draught)

ingredients.item: ghost gloop, wrung from a spectral bedsheet
swamp sludge, the greener the better
witch's old sock, left-footed, unwashed since the Tudors
troll toenails, curled like party horns
cobweb candyfloss, collected from a haunted attic
jellied cyclops eyeball, the size of a football
powdered dragon scales, for shimmer and regret

steps: Wait for a gibbous moon. Hold the sock at arm's length and whisper 'sorry' to it. Drop it into a large bowl that has seen things.
Pour in the swamp sludge. Stir widdershins thirteen times with a spoon made of spooky silence until the sock stops complaining.
Dollop on the goblin bogey custard. Add the ghost gloop, which will wobble upwards. This is normal. Do not make eye contact.
Perch the cyclops eyeball on top. Rotate it until it faces the neighbours. Tuck in the troll toenails like a crown of mild disappointment.
Drape with cobweb candyfloss, dust with dragon scales, and lean the gargoyle wafers around the edge. Serve to nobody. Cackle once.
image_prompt: A large glass trifle bowl of luminous green ghost gloop in wobbly layers, with swampy sludge at the bottom, yellow-green bogey custard in the middle, and a giant jellied eyeball on top. Grey cobweb candyfloss drapes over the rim, curled troll toenails and winged wafers poke out, and a stripy old sock hangs off the side.
alt_text: A glass bowl of glowing green slime layers topped with a giant eyeball, cobwebby candyfloss, curly toenails, wafers and a hanging stripy sock.
caption_hook:
Today's pudding is a ghost's leftovers, a sock and one very nosy eyeball.
Strictly a prop. Not food. Not even close.
Would you dare to serve this at your Halloween party, or would the sock tell on you?
